role: Main-actor wake-up primitive: tasks waiting on strap state suspend in wait(timeout:) and are resumed by fire() (true), timeout (false) or cancellation (false).
types: StrapSignal: class (@MainActor final) — continuation registry with per-waiter timeout tasks; one instance lives on StrapLinkRuntime.signal
toplevel: Two empty dictionaries initialised at declaration.

units.does: Resumes every pending waiter with true and cancels/clears all timeout tasks.
Suspends the caller until fire(), the optional timeout, or task cancellation; returns true only for fire().
Registers a continuation (resuming false at once if the task is already cancelled) and, when a timeout is given, a Task that sleeps max(timeout,0) seconds then resolves the waiter with false.

branches.effect: resumes false immediately and does not register
returns after registering: waits only for fire()/cancel
returns without resolving; else resolves the waiter with false

units.does: Removes and cancels the waiter's timer and resumes its continuation (if still present) with the given value.
